scripts.db:test:app:stripe: tsx supabase/tests/app/booking-routes.test.mts && tsx supabase/tests/app/provider-bookings.test.mts && tsx supabase/tests/app/booking-jobs.test.mts && tsx supabase/tests/app/cancellations.test.mts && tsx supabase/tests/app/admin-actions.test.mts && tsx supabase/tests/app/payout-holds.test.mts
scripts.db:push: npm run db:test && supabase db push && npm run db:types && npm run db:docs
scripts.db:types: supabase gen types typescript --linked --schema public,private > packages/types/src/database.ts.tmp && mv packages/types/src/database.ts.tmp packages/types/src/database.ts
